tasks.title: Resolve standalone environment definitions and locks
tasks.goal: Use the existing Vibe solver for environment consumers without requiring a repository or inventing another dependency grammar.
steps: Parse environment desired roots/choices and target constraints into the shared M-05 normalized request model.
Add build/tool/runtime roles and backend-qualified requirements while keeping foreign versions opaque; solve each environment in its own domain.
Return exact requested and resolved closures, selected source/prebuilt strategy, freshness and unsatisfied constraints through pure plan/explain services.
positive_cases: A plain directory without Git defines and resolves an environment.
Two environments choose different package versions without sharing mutable lock state.
negative_cases: Role-specific ABI constraints disappear on a retry.
A foreign backend constraint is lossy-converted to Vibe SemVer.

tasks.safe_stop: The environment resolves to a captured lock or typed unsat/needs-input result; nothing is installed.
notes: Planned permanent destination: vibevm/vibespecs/common/PROP-064-runtime-package-management.xml; forward metadata only.
The environment/ module is a proposed composition cell in the existing orchestrator; its owning export file is included for registration. Refine the perimeter before touching any additional crate.

Bind the smallest affected target and exact cases before compiling. Discover from source/metadata, then list only the bound target/case and require a nonzero match. Add broader checks only for demonstrated affected behavior that the selected checks cannot establish.
Registration perimeter includes existing crate manifests and module owners only for required exports/dependencies; do not change unrelated declarations.

tasks.title: Implement replaceable source and realization supply paths
tasks.goal: Make fetch and substitution obey exact captures across local mirrors and offline replay.
steps: Separate logical identity and expected digests from replaceable local/Git/HTTP/artifact/OCI locators in the lock.
Prepare exact transitive source, toolchain, bootstrap and runtime inputs through admitted fetch; preserve native repository verification and producer policies.
Implement missing-capture diagnostics, authorized binary-cache substitution and all-input replay without implicit fallback to GitHub/latest/network.
positive_cases: An exact local mirror supplies the same captured bytes with retained origin provenance.
Offline missing realization rebuilds only when complete inputs and build authority exist.
negative_cases: Different mirror bytes are accepted under an existing identity.
Offline mode performs an undocumented control-plane request.
